premises.text: Aspiring artists lack access to quality producers or cannot afford a music career
premises.evidence_span: they either don't have access to quality producers or they can't afford to pursue a career in music

premises.text: Rekogram is an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, studio, and social network for original songs with producers for under $5
premises.evidence_span: Rekogram is an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, a recording studio, and a social network that allows our users to create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5

premises.text: Users discover beats, write and record to them, shoot video, and share to social networks including Rekogram
premises.evidence_span: Our users can discover beats, they can write songs to those beats, they can record songs to those beats, and they can also shoot a video to that song that they just created

premises.text: The marketplace connects producers who lack artist relationships with artists who lack access/affordability
premises.evidence_span: We're the user-friendly, convenient, and affordable solution that connects producer Tony with aspiring artist Willie

premises.text: Producers pay $9.99/month or $90/year to upload; platform takes 20% of leases/sales and returns 50% royalties to producers
premises.evidence_span: We basically charge producers $9.99 a month or $90 a year to upload our beats to our platform

premises.text: Affiliate marketers, field evangelists, and celebrity fan outreach drive adoption
premises.evidence_span: We currently have 10 affiliate marketing companies out there in the music space that are helping promote our application

premises.text: Differentiation is original-content creation without reliance on major-label licensing
premises.evidence_span: we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

domains.name: Access gap for aspiring artists and producers

value.text: Anyone worldwide can awaken their inner musician by creating original songs affordably on a phone
value.evidence_span: empowers anyone, regardless of where they live in the world or how much money they have, the ability to awaken their inner musician

causal_links.evidence_span: create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5
we make money for producers like Tony, and we provide access and save money for guys like Willie
